capabilities.summary: Resolved theme tokens per mode for non-web UIs: brand file parsing, derived dark accent, WCAG 2.x contrast repair, W3C design-token JSON emission (rightkit-theme generate --json)
policyNotes: Declaration-only: colour arithmetic is not an ownership fingerprint.
The resolver is a port of @rightkit/theme (packages/theme/src/brand.ts, color.ts); the TypeScript package stays the web owner and both read the same brand.json.
